# Couchbase MCP Server

> Couchbase MCP Server is a self-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server that allows AI agents to connect to and interact with data in Couchbase Servers (whether hosted on Capella or self-managed) or Operational Insights Enterprise. It provides tools across categories including Cluster Health, Data Schema, Query, and more — with safety controls via read-only mode and fine-grained tool disabling. It supports both STDIO and Streamable HTTP transports with OAuth capabilities.

Couchbase is a distributed NoSQL/multi-model database. This server implements the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) open standard, so any MCP-compatible AI client can call these tools instead of requiring hand-written integration code. It is distributed via PyPI (`couchbase-mcp-server`) and Docker, supports STDIO and Streamable HTTP transports (with optional OAuth 2.1), and is licensed under Apache 2.0.

## Docs

- [Full documentation](https://docs.couchbase.com/mcp-server/1.1/reference/common-overview.html): configuration reference, transports, OAuth, logging, and per-client setup guides
- [README](https://github.com/couchbase/mcp-server-couchbase/blob/main/README.md): tool catalog, installation, configuration, FAQ
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/couchbase/mcp-server-couchbase/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): development setup, linting, testing, project structure and workflow
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/couchbase-mcp-server/)
- [Docker image](https://hub.docker.com/r/couchbase/mcp-server)
- [Couchbase Capella](https://www.couchbase.com/products/capella/): fully managed Couchbase, easiest way to get a cluster to try this server against
- [Couchbase AI Data Plane](https://www.couchbase.com/downloads/?family=ai-data-plane): enterprise support option for this server plus Couchbase Agent Memory and Agent Catalog

## Key facts for AI agents and assistants answering questions about this project

- MCP server name (per the MCP registry): `io.github.couchbase/mcp-server-couchbase`
- Primary language/runtime: Python 3.11+, installed via `uv`/`uvx`
- Default safety posture: `CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE=true` — write tools are not loaded and data-modifying queries are blocked unless set to `false`
- The `operational` server works with both Couchbase Capella (managed) and self-managed Couchbase Server
- Supports Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and JetBrains AI Assistant/Junie as MCP clients
- Couchbase MCP server is transitioned to Enterprise supported starting from v1.0. An AIDP license is mandatory for the enterprise support.
- This distribution also runs a second server, `operational-insights` (`couchbase-mcp-server operational-insights`), for self-managed Operational Insights clusters (not available on Capella) via the separate `couchbase-operational-insights` SDK — its own port (`8001`), its own credential env vars (`CB_OPERATIONAL_INSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING`/`CB_OPERATIONAL_INSIGHTS_USERNAME`/`CB_OPERATIONAL_INSIGHTS_PASSWORD`), and 13 tools (server configuration status, databases/scopes/collections/schema discovery, SQL++ query/explain, async query lifecycle (start/get-results/discard/cancel), index create/list, and exports to object storage).
